synopsis: ACTS stands for Automated Combinatorial Testing for Software and is NIST's public-domain covering-array generator [f14114, f6821]. Chapter 9 identifies ACTS, PICT and commercial test-design tools as typical tooling for covering arrays [f7237]. It also states that open-source generators such as PICT and commercial tools perform the same covering-array generation job as ACTS, establishing alternatives without comparing their performance or suitability [f6822].

relations.note: Both identify NIST ACTS as a public-domain generator.
Equivalent covering-array functionality supports listing PICT and commercial tools alongside ACTS.
